fields.text: One still wakes into a four-second clip: Muse draws the first frame ($0.01), Grok Imagine Video 1.5 (`xai/grok-imagine-video/v1.5/image-to-video`) rides it into motion (480p, 4s; catalog $0.204/s + $0.017 image fee ≈ $0.83 video). Not Animate a product still (MiniMax H3 Spicy asphalt rain). Change still and motion briefs together. Inspect the cyan pulse; a seamless loop is not promised.

A compact matte-charcoal pocket night-ride radio resting on a wet rooftop concrete ledge. One sharp lightning-bolt chevron in electric cyan on the faceplate. Cyan edge light from camera-right, night-city skyline below the ledge, close three-quarter view, entire radio visible, clear chevron silhouette, no text or logos.

Locked camera for four seconds. Subtle rain beads on the rooftop ledge. Midway, the electric-cyan lightning chevron pulses once. The radio stays still. Preserve its shape and placement; no cuts, new objects or camera motion.
